historical_redacted_proposal.rollback: Before commit, transaction rollback must restore all preimages. After commit, backup restoration is safe only while the same exclusion/admission boundary is still retained and no subsequent work has been released. Once another queued job starts, a row-only rollback cannot undo its effects. Therefore this is not an automatically reversible repair under the current maintenance grant.
